x.name: Kobeissi Letter
x.text:
US buybacks are set to rise to unprecedented levels:

US buyback authorizations are up +13% YoY so far in 2026, to a record $1.305 trillion.

Buyback authorizations are now on track for their 4th consecutive annual increase, the longest such streak in at least 20 years.

Since the 2020 low, buyback authorizations have more than quadrupled.

Meanwhile, executed buybacks grew +20% YoY in Q2 2026, their largest increase since Q1 2025.

This also marks the 4th consecutive quarterly increase, with H1 2026 up +15% year-over-year.

We expect a large wave of US stock buybacks ahead.

x.name: Ray Dalio
x.text:
Proximate causes are typically the actions (or lack of actions) that lead to problems, so they are described with verbs (I missed the train because I didn't check the train schedule). 

Root causes run much deeper and they are typically described with adjectives (I didn't check the train schedule because I am forgetful). 

You can only truly solve your problems by removing their root causes, and to do that, you must distinguish the symptoms from the disease. #principleoftheday

x.name: Kobeissi Letter
x.text:
BREAKING: The total value of the US stock market has surged to 350% of the US M2 money supply, the highest level since the 2000 Dot-Com Bubble.

Since the 2022 bear market, this ratio has surged +170 percentage points.

Over this period, the S&P 500 has rallied +118%, while M2 has risen +9%.

In other words, the stock market's gain has outpaced the money supply growth by 13x.

The last time equity market growth exceeded M2 growth by a larger amount was from 1995 to 1999.

Asset owners are winning.

PREDICTION MARKETS ARE DISRUPTING THE SPORTS BETTING INDUSTRY

Wall Street initially underestimated prediction markets, according to Bank of America's Shaun Kelley.

Platforms like Kalshi have challenged traditional sportsbooks, including DraftKings and FanDuel.

Their key advantages: access across all 50 U.S. states and eligibility for users 18 and older, Kelley says.

The key takeaway: Prediction markets are expanding the competitive threat to established sports betting operators.

Source: Bank of America / NEXTPredict Summit
